question: Daunting Defender prevents 1 damage from any source dealt to Cleric creatures I control. When Pyroclasm deals 2 damage to each creature, does each of my Clerics take only 1 damage?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: each Cleric you control takes 1 damage, and every other creature takes 2.
expected.answer: Daunting Defender says “If a source would deal damage to a Cleric creature you control, prevent 1 of that damage.” Pyroclasm says “Pyroclasm deals 2 damage to each creature.” Pyroclasm will deal 1 damage to each Cleric creature controlled by Daunting Defender’s controller. It will deal 2 damage to each other creature.
